summary: Detached job spawned by recall-gate.mjs spawnRefresh when any active note lacks a vector matching its text hash: takes .gate/refresh.lock (stale after 15 min), loads the embedder with allowRemote=true (the only place the model is downloaded), embeds stale notes one at a time (batching pads to the longest note), drops vectors of removed notes, writes vectors.json via temp+rename. Measured: 159 notes in ~131 s.
